newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti fails to reopen, next try 1450GMT.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti fails to reopen, next try 1450GMT.

text.p: Shares in loss-making Italian information technology group Olivetti failed to resume trading after going 20 percent limit down in Milan and dealers said the next try to restart trade would be at 1450 GMT.
The slide in Olivetti shares earlier triggered automatic suspension at 600 lire after they were offered at 595 lire, dealers said.
The Italian bourse closes at 1500 GMT.
Opening trade in Olivetti shares was delayed for two hours earlier on Monday as pre-bourse price quotes exceeded fluctuation limits set by the stock market council.

The share eventually opened at 619 lire just after 1000 GMT, 17.4 percent down on the last traded price of 749.4 on Wednesday, once the stock market council widened fluctuation bands to 20 percent from the regular 10 percent.
Olivetti had been suspended by bourse watchdog Consob throughout Thursday and Friday while the authority waited for an Olivetti statement clarifying its half year accounts.
